prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1181; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with pain and swelling of the left wrist. Imaging and physical examination clearly confirm a distal radius fracture, and the treating team immobilized the wrist and arranged follow-up. Over five visits the patient's course followed a typical pattern: pain and swelling were managed with standard analgesia, the cast was checked and later removed, and range-of-motion exercises were introduced as healing progressed. Visit frequency tapered as the patient improved and grip strength and mobility returned toward baseline. No prior injury to the same area is known from the history obtained. Causation relative to this collision is not yet clear and should be reviewed once the complete records are available. Billed services correspond to the documented visits without repeated charges for the same procedures. Ongoing monitoring is recommended, with a return visit if new or worsening symptoms develop.
